text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, crushed my time! Time for
another lap!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you think this is enough to take me
out? I'll
crush my record again, just you
watch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm gonna need a whole lot of
trainin' if I
wanna take down all of my
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But, man, havin' a trustworthy partner
really helps
things along. Ain't that
right, Teach?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
With you around, I can train my heart
out without
worryin' about anything.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much in the brains
department, but
I've got you to make up
for that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right,
back to business! I've gotta get
used to
how that run felt just now.
